description: This PHP source file contains the class `TaxRate` which is part of the OpenCart admin localisation controllers. It manages CRUD operations, listing, and form handling for tax rate configurations in the admin panel.

classes.name: TaxRate
classes.description: Controller class for managing tax rates in the OpenCart admin localisation module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point; loads language, sets page title, builds URL with sorting and pagination, prepares data, and renders the tax rate listing view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of tax rates, sets response output with formatted list.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML table with the list of tax rates, including sorting, pagination, and action links.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Handles display and processing of the tax rate creation/edit form, including loading existing data, setting up form fields, and rendering the form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submission for saving or updating a tax rate, including validation, data loading, and redirects.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Main logic for handling the saving of tax rate data, including permission checks, validation, creating or updating records, and returning JSON responses.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected tax rates, including permission validation, associated rules cleanup, and returning success or error messages.
